args.description: jumps straight up: a quick crouch, springs up, then tucks the knees up in mid-air, a huge spiked black and red greatsword, larger and more jagged held ready in one hand, hair and clothes fly upward; the last frames stay high in the air in that tucked pose, the feet never come back down. The whole weapon stays inside the picture. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves him), always facing right, seen from the side; keep his look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what he holds: no effect, no motion streak, no speed lines, no trail behind the limbs or the weapon, no glow, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground, the whole body inside the picture. Every frame shows the arms, legs and weapon clearly in a crisp pose, never blurred.
args.subject_description: a young man with spiky black hair streaked with red, red eyes, a long red scarf, an open black and red coat over a bare chest, black trousers, red and black boots, holding a huge spiked black and red greatsword, larger and more jagged
args.initial_pose: fighting stance facing right, holding a huge spiked black and red greatsword, larger and more jagged
